evals.prompt: Rancang struktur layout hero section untuk FigCraft Live Canvas dengan MCP batch payload yang aman anti-konflik.
evals.expected_output: Atomic batch payload with document target, select: false on every create, exclusive parentId, auto-layout parameters, and no emoji icons.
assertions: atomic batch payload with onError abort
Auto Layout vertical/horizontal with gap and padding

evals.prompt: Bagaimana aturan partisi kanvas dan penanganan undo/redo saat koordinasi multi-agent di FigCraft Live?
evals.expected_output: Explains exclusive parentId partitioning per section, forbids global undo/redo, forbids select dependency, and requires explicit node ID targeting.
assertions: prohibits global undo/redo during multi-agent turns
does not rely on global selection

evals.prompt: Buatkan token warna dan spesifikasi Auto Layout untuk asymmetric bento dashboard card di FigCraft.
evals.expected_output: Hex color tokens with WCAG AAA contrast, concentric corner radius formula, and nested auto-layout frame configuration.
assertions: hex color tokens for surface, border, text, and accent
nested auto-layout properties (layout, gap, padding, sizingH)
asymmetric hierarchy instead of generic 3-card stack
